entities.summary: Miguel de la Quadra-Salcedo y Gayarre was a Spanish reporter and Olympic athlete. He was the director and founder of cultural program Aventura 92, nowadays named as Ruta Quetzal BBVA. Although he was born in Madrid, he was always recognized as Basque-Navarre.
